d: "A series of strange wildlife calls brings Turtleman and Neal James into some of the wildest animal encounters imaginable! From slippery snakes and stubborn turtles to raccoons and mink, these missions involve unexpected captures, unusual rescue situations and plenty of surprises. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, takes on a variety of wild animal rescue and removal challenges, bringing his hands-on experience to every encounter.
